+    def filter_members(obj: Any, imported: bool = True) -> List[str]:
+        """Filter members based on whether they are imported.
+        
+        Args:
+            obj: The object to filter members from
+            imported: If True, include all members. If False, only include members
+                     defined in the object's module.
+        """
+        items = []  # type: List[str]
+        for name in dir(obj):
+            try:
+                value = safe_getattr(obj, name)
+            except AttributeError:
+                continue
+            # Include member if:
+            # 1. imported is True (include all), OR
+            # 2. The member's __module__ matches the object's __name__ (it's defined in this module)
+            if imported or getattr(value, '__module__', None) == obj.__name__:
+                items.append(name)
+        return items
